attractions.name: Peel Castle
attractions.description: Iconic 11th century castle on St Patrick's Isle. Home to the legendary Moddey Dhoo (Black Dog). Stunning views over Peel Bay.

attractions.name: Castle Rushen
attractions.description: One of the best preserved medieval castles in Europe, in the heart of Castletown. Former seat of the Kings of Mann.

attractions.name: Manx Museum
attractions.description: The island's national museum in Douglas. Tells the full story of Mann from prehistoric times to the present. Free entry.

attractions.name: Laxey Wheel (Lady Isabella)
attractions.description: The world's largest working waterwheel at 22 metres. Built in 1854 to pump water from Laxey mines. A UNESCO heritage landmark.

attractions.name: Snaefell Mountain Railway
attractions.description: Electric mountain railway to the summit of Snaefell (621m). On a clear day you can see England, Scotland, Ireland and Wales — six kingdoms!

attractions.name: Manx Electric Railway
attractions.description: Historic electric tram running 18 miles from Douglas to Ramsey along the spectacular east coast. One of the oldest surviving electric railways in the world, dating from 1893.

attractions.name: Steam Railway
attractions.description: Victorian steam railway running 15 miles from Douglas to Port Erin. Steam-hauled through stunning Manx countryside.
attractions.address: Douglas Station, North Quay, Douglas, IM1 4LE

attractions.name: TT Mountain Course
attractions.description: The legendary 37.73-mile road racing circuit. Drive it yourself outside race season! Key spots: Governors Bridge, Sulby Straight, Ramsey Hairpin, Creg-ny-Baa.
attractions.address: TT Grandstand, Glencrutchery Road, Douglas, IM2 6DA

attractions.name: Douglas Promenade
attractions.description: The famous 2-mile Victorian promenade curving around Douglas Bay. Home to the horse trams, hotels, and restaurants. Beautiful at sunset.

attractions.name: Cregneash Village
attractions.description: Open-air folk museum in a traditional Manx crofting village. See how life was lived 200 years ago. Loaghtan sheep, thatched cottages, craft demonstrations.

attractions.name: Niarbyl Bay
attractions.description: Remote, breathtakingly beautiful bay on the west coast. Geological fault line visible in rocks. Featured in film 'Waking Ned'. Must for photographers.

attractions.name: Curraghs Wildlife Park
attractions.description: The island's only zoo, set in a wetland nature reserve. Home to lemurs, flamingos, red pandas, penguins and more. Great for families.

attractions.name: Point of Ayre Lighthouse
attractions.description: The most northerly point of the Isle of Man. Historic lighthouse from 1818. Stunning views across the Irish Sea to Scotland.

attractions.name: Horse Trams
attractions.description: Victorian horse-drawn trams along Douglas Promenade. Dating from 1876, among the oldest surviving horse trams in the world.

attractions.name: Ballaugh Bridge (TT Jump)
attractions.description: The famous jumping point on the TT course. Bikes become airborne here — one of the most photographed spots in motorsport. Free to watch.
attractions.openingHours: Race weeks for racing; road open otherwise
